answer_1.quote: In this work, we introduce MILDSum (Multilingual Indian Legal Document Summarization), a dataset consisting of 3,122 case judgments from multiple High Courts and the Supreme Court of India in English, along with the summaries in both English and Hindi, drafted by legal practitioners.
answer_1.outputs: summaries in English and Hindi from English legal documents

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of the summaries generated by the models, we considered these standard metrics -ROUGE , and BERTScore . Specifically, we reported the F1 scores of ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore.
